timeline.title: B.S. Electrical Engineering
timeline.body: Coursework in analog electronics, semiconductor devices, signals and systems, and electromagnetics. Self-directed work in analog IC design on the sky130 open PDK alongside it.

timeline.title: Add a research or lab position
timeline.body: One or two sentences on what you actually built or measured — the instrument, the circuit, the result. Not the topic area.

timeline.title: Add a tapeout, award, or competition result
timeline.body: If you have taped out, name the shuttle and the date — for example "sky130 via the Efabless MPW shuttle". A die photo or GDS render on the home page is the strongest single signal an IC portfolio can carry.

courses.title: Add a course
courses.note: Replace with the courses that back your claims — electronics, devices, signals, fields. Code and term are optional.
